subject.title: Feature: Pre-compaction agent notification, structured handoff window, and deferral mechanism

question: Should OpenClaw add an agent-controlled pre-compaction lifecycle contract here, and which scope is allowed: warnings only, structured handoff/checkpoint, bounded deferral, or no new lifecycle surface?
rationale: This cannot be resolved as cleanup because the request changes public config, session continuity, write timing, and authority carryover at the compaction boundary.

options.title: Adopt Warning And Handoff Only
options.body: Add a narrow opt-in warning plus structured handoff/checkpoint path while leaving agent-requested deferral out until authority semantics are settled.

options.title: Adopt Full Bounded Deferral
options.body: Allow warning, handoff, and DEFER only with strict max duration, audit trail, idempotent checkpoint matching, and approval expiry rules.

options.title: Decline New Lifecycle Surface
options.body: Keep memoryFlush, notifyUser, hooks, and checkpoints as the supported compaction surfaces and document the remaining limits.

recommendation.title: Adopt Warning And Handoff Only
recommendation.body: Add a narrow opt-in warning plus structured handoff/checkpoint path while leaving agent-requested deferral out until authority semantics are settled.

likelyOwner.reason: The memoryFlush implementation is the closest current pre-compaction lifecycle behavior and is central to the requested handoff path.
